description: This file contains the implementation of the MainActivity class for an Android application that demonstrates video playback using MediaCodec API with a TextureView. It initializes media components, handles user interaction to start playback, and manages media rendering and cleanup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that uses TextureView and MediaCodec to decode and display a video.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and finds view references.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pausing, stops animations, and releases media resources.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, specifically starting video playback.

methods.name: startPlayback
methods.description: Sets up media extractor, selects the video track, initializes the decoder, and starts the rendering loop via TimeAnimator.
